body.body:
## Summary

Stage 1 of Factory Core (Stage 4B §11): an offline, deterministic validator and dependency planner.

- `factory validate <project-dir>`: checks the manifest, tasks, architecture profiles and ADR front matter against versioned schemas. Also checks cross-references (repositories, profiles, ADRs, outputs, dependency targets), detects cycles, and rejects duplicate ids, self-dependencies, unknown assurance levels and self-declared approval fields. Errors name the file and field.
- `factory plan <project-dir> --evidence <snapshot.json>`: pure evaluation of the five assurance levels and the start / open-PR / merge / complete gates, with nested reason codes. Text or JSON output; JSON is byte-identical for identical inputs.
- Evidence snapshots accept only `provenance.kind: simulated`, and plan output always reports `"authenticated": false`. Fixture approvals are not human approvals.

Design and reconciliation: `docs/decisions/0001-stage1-implementation-decisions.md` and `docs/architecture/planning-model.md`.

## Scope limits

No network access, GitHub calls, agent dispatch, push, merge, deploy, or writes to the project directory. `dispatch.enabled: true` is rejected.

## Tests

- Acceptance suite T1–T16: `tests/acceptance/test_stage1_acceptance.py`.
- Edge cases: duplicate ids, self-dependencies, missing targets, invalid YAML, duplicate keys, malformed snapshots, unknown profiles, profile/repository mismatches, missing ADRs and research files, invalid ADR revisions, mixed gates, cross-repository chains, check provenance rules, path traversal and symlink escape.
- CI runs the suite inside a network namespace with no interfaces, and also runs a clean wheel install.

## Known limitation

Branch protection could not be enabled. GitHub returns HTTP 403 for protection on private repositories on the Free plan, so `main`/`dev` are protected by convention only until a human decides (see decision 0001, "Blocked").

Leave unmerged for human review.
